(rule!
 ;; Overlay the TRANSPOSE onto the grid: every non-zero cell also lands at
 ;; its mirrored (c, r) position.
 (overlay g (transpose g)))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let* ([completed (overlay g (transpose g))]
         [parts (objects completed 0)]
         [blank (empty-grid (rows completed) (cols completed) 0)])
    (if (empty? parts)
        blank
        (let ([target (apply max (map obj-size parts))])
          (for/fold ([out blank]) ([part (in-list parts)])
            (if (= (obj-size part) target)
                (paint-cells out (obj-cells part) (obj-color part))
                out)))))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let* ([completed (transpose g)]
         [parts (filter (lambda (part) #t) (objects completed 0))]
         [score (lambda (part) (obj-size part))]
         [chosen (if (empty? parts) '() (let ([target (apply min (map score parts))]) (filter (lambda (part) (= (score part) target)) parts)))]
         [selected (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
                             ([part (in-list chosen)])
                      (for/fold ([painted out]) ([p (in-list (obj-cells part))])
                        (paint-cells painted (list p) (cell-at completed (first p) (second p)))))])
    selected)))
